$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for LAO (lo-LA): ພູມແພ້, ແພ້ bound to what it is (ແພ້ຖົ່ວ, ແພ້ນົມ… / ຂ້ອຍແພ້ / ອາການແພ້), ບໍ່ມີ / ບໍ່ໃສ່ <allergen>, <allergen> ບໍ່ໄດ້ / ກິນບໍ່ໄດ້, ຍ່ອຍບໍ່ໄດ້, ບໍ່ທົນຕໍ່, ກລູເຕັນຟຣີ, ປອດໄພ, ເໝາະສຳລັບ, ປົນເປື້ອນ, ອາດມີສ່ວນປະສົມ, ເຊລີແອັກ, ແລັກໂຕສ. Lao runs words together; vowel signs above/below and tone marks are stripped on both sides (the leading vowels ເ ແ ໂ ໃ ໄ stay), so every stem is checked by its run-on skeleton, and words bound to an allergen are listed joined and spaced. Bare ແພ້ is NOT a stem (→ the skeleton of ແພງ, expensive, and ແພດ, doctor), nor bare ບໍ່ໃສ່ (→ inside ກັບໃສ່) or bare ບໍ່ມີ, and ປູ (crab) is bound only to ແພ້ (ບໍ່ມີປູ → the skeleton of ບໍ່ມີປັນຫາ, no problem; ປູບໍ່ໄດ້ → inside ໄປບໍ່ໄດ້, cannot go). OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
